Definition: iron (as cutting); by extension, an iron implement
BiblicalUsage: Barzel is iron, the metal that cuts and breaks and holds an edge. Moses promises a land whose stones are iron, Goliath's spearhead weighs six hundred shekels of iron, the proverb says iron sharpens iron and a man sharpens his friend, and the psalm says the Son will break the nations with a rod of iron.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe iron is the Bible's picture of strength that can serve or crush, because the same metal arms a giant and sharpens a friend. God gives iron to a land He loves and a rod of iron to a Son He has anointed, and I hold that strength is only good when the hand that holds it belongs to God.
